Great Poké in a Surprising Setting!
Mar 2026 • Friends
A Vietnamese friend who lives in Hanoi brought us to Kenkō for lunch. She goes there often, and we soon found out why! The poké was absolutely top-notch: crisp, fresh, and delectable. We have eaten a lot of poké, including on several Hawaiian islands. Crazy as it is to say, the poké at this modest place in Hanoi ranks among the best!
